spec.context: RETAKE of the same zero-data profile in LIGHT mode — top + fully-scrolled-bottom frames. Judge the union: honest-empty calm (no orphan headings, no phantom gaps), similar doctors rows readable with fees, share row, sticky "Book appointment — ₹300", education line "2 yrs · MD · Gandhinagar, Gujarat" untruncated, grey captions AA on white.

defects.what: Back chevron button appears smaller than 44px square (approx 56x36 pill; vertical height under 44px)

Sticky CTA is near-black (#1A1A19) on white canvas — reads as the strongest element, acceptable as CTA, but teal accent law has no live/selected usage anywhere; not a violation, just noting no accent present

measured_notes: Education line '2 yrs · MD · Gandhinagar, Gujarat' fully rendered, no ellipsis
Fee '₹300' is largest text on screen (~36-40px) after name; hierarchy law (3) satisfied on surface 1
7-day clinic hours rendered; Sunday shown greyed 'Closed' — estimated grey ~#6b6b6b on white, ~4.9:1, passes AA
Stats line '17 visits · 4 patients on Aturseva' is quiet grey caption, AA-compliant grey on white (~4.5:1+)
Similar doctors rows show readable fees (₹500/₹400/₹400) with chevrons; row height ~64-72px, touch targets >= 44px
Empty profile renders no orphan headings: no ratings card, services, surgeries, awards, health tips, or About section present — hide-if-empty honored
Screen gutters approx 16px consistent; card radius consistent (~12px) across fee card, hours card, practices card, similar-doctors card
Sticky CTA 'Book appointment — ₹300' matches fee ₹300 exactly — honest
Share row 'Share on WhatsApp' present, approx 44-48px tall
No truncation/ellipsis seen on any patient-decision content: names, localities, fees, hours all fully rendered
non_blocking_notes: Avatar initials 'R' use grey letterform; fine on quiet canvas
'Similar doctors' heading overlaps the sticky CTA in the top frame — expected mid-scroll artifact of frame stitching, not a layout defect
Back button pill width could grow slightly for a more comfortable target
Duplicate initials 'DP' for two different doctors (Prod Final, Pack Test) — cosmetic, correct initials logic but repetitive
verdict.one_line: An honest, calm zero-data profile: fee-first hierarchy, complete untruncated hours and education, real fees on similar-doctor rows, hide-if-empty fully honored — only a sub-44px Back button and a missing accent state keep it from flawless.
